## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets the release train (`rc/<version>`), not `main`. Only repo
      infra that GitHub reads from the default branch goes to `main`
- [ ] CI passes on macOS, Windows and Linux
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] If the app now keeps something new on disk, changes another program's
      settings or reaches the network, SECURITY.md says so
- [ ] Updated the README if behaviour changed; it is the front page
